name: Ragtop
author: Stan Clemance
description: On-screen keyboard (OSK) and tablet mode for Omarchy on Hyprland. Touchscreen or mouse input; automatic rotation and resizing for convertible 2-in-1 devices. Mobile, 60%, 75% and 80% TKL layouts; accents, dead keys and AltGr. Nine keyboard themes, Glass styling and optional backlighting. Beta: swipe typing, word suggestions and Chinese, Japanese, Korean (CJK) input. Typing-memory controls and optional lock screen/system overlay support.

barWidget.description: The on-screen keyboard and screen rotation, always in the bar
